attributes.residual: serve_blits stands at real 251, insns 279/280, opcode multiset 7t (was 11t): target-only +1 lwzu +2 mr, ours-only -2 addi -2 lwz. THREE named clusters remain. (1) CASE 5 lwzu, EXHAUSTED at three probes on one cluster. Mechanism: MWCC schedules case 5's `addi r19,r21,8` ABOVE the gFrameTicks SDA load, breaking the addi/lwz adjacency the peephole needs to emit lwzu; the structurally IDENTICAL case 6/7 block schedules the gFrameTicks load first and does fuse. The choice differs between two sibling switch arms under the same source shape. Probes: store-before-shift reorder NEUTRAL; `gFrameTicks + *tp` operand swap REGRESSED 251->253; declaration/initializer split NEUTRAL. Both spellings are also LESS faithful than the raw form (target reads 4(r19), not through sp), so the raw form was restored. (3) The +2 mr clamp coloring in case 5 (`mullw r0` then `mr r20,r0` vs our direct `mullw r18`) - untouched this pass, REGISTER_ONLY.
